gizmo.title: Ishadi le-radar
gizmo.description: Ishadi le-radar (lesicabucabu) lamamodeli okuvuthwa nokunikeza amaphuzu ezici, njenge-HEOSAT. Lifaka umbhalo ongenye indlela nethebula ledatha.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Isihloko seshadi; futhi sisetshenziswa njengegama lalo elifinyelelekayo.

configure.title: Izigaba
configure.description: Isigaba esisodwa emugqeni ngamunye. Kudingeka okungenani ezi-3.

configure.title: Amaphuzu
configure.description: Izinombolo ezihlukaniswe ngokhefana, eyodwa isigaba ngasinye ngokulandelana okufanayo.

configure.title: Amaphuzu okuhlosiwe
configure.description: Izinombolo ezihlukaniswe ngokhefana, eyodwa isigaba ngasinye ngokulandelana okufanayo.

configure.title: Kuhlangene
configure.description: Ishadi elincane elingenawo amalebula, isichasiselo noma ithebula ledatha. Zulazula phezu kwephuzu ukuze ubone amanani alo.
